name: Berlinale 2027
job: Help visitors distinguish the festival, industry programmes and audience days, and compare screening transfers without assuming accreditation guarantees entry.
facets: Festival and industry programme date ranges
source_notes: Berlinale lists festival 10–21 February, European Film Market 10–16, Co-Production Market 13–16, Talents 12–17; awards 19 February and audience days 20–21. Specific programme and ticket availability require official verification.
